hypothesis: Overlap fresh paired RGB capture with bounded solo approach drive to reduce unnecessary stop-observe wait, preserving original motion horizon and settled final entry.
evidence: Previously completed approach had 17-22 percent issued-drive duty; near drive-only overlap theoretical saving about9s, not established mission gain.
control: Reference v28 RGB versus v29 --rolling-visual-servo; same saved plan, physical scene, camera, common models, open/seed11/dock_a/local_contact_fine/grasp overlap/native1x/video10/weldOFF.

diagnostic.purpose: Detect mechanical integration failures, keep all outcomes outside final comparison. Source changes require new candidate ID/frozen source; no relabeling failures.

claim_gate.success: Both cargo delivered, placement/release/clearance and source/input/lease/RGB audits valid for all six trials. Failures do not count as faster completion.
claim_gate.speed: Each of three matched pairs faster and median relative full mission wall reduction >=5 percent; also report approach-only duration/duty and wall/SIM ratio. Narrow nearby-pose component claim only.
claim_gate.moving_capture: Hash-linked paired own/TOP observations actually captured inside a previously issued rolling command window; never infer physical motion from command alone.

boundaries: No GT, measured joints or contact feedback to student.
Only ownRGB/TOP and self-issued command history control actions.
Native viewer at1x, no concurrent CPU-heavy job, no rendering or video inspection during timed trial.
No new LLM messages in saved-plan replay, no communication efficacy claim.
No default rollout or main merge without separate approval.
